# The University of Sydney

> > Australia's first university offering world-class education, research, and student support across undergraduate, postgraduate, and research programs.

The University of Sydney is a leading Australian institution ranked highly in QS World University Rankings, serving domestic and international students with comprehensive admission pathways, scholarships, and specialized research initiatives including the Henry Halloran Urban and Regional Research Initiative focused on urban planning and sustainable development.

## Key Topics

- ATAR and UAC admissions
- International student recruitment
- Scholarships and financial aid
- Henry Halloran Urban and Regional Research Initiative
- Educational Access Scheme (EAS)
- Urban planning and regional development
- Study abroad and exchange programs
- Undergraduate and postgraduate programs
- Student support services
- Sustainable development research
- Mental health and climate change research
- Festival of Urbanism
- Tertiary Preparation Certificate (TPC)
- Honours programs
- Application pathways and transfers

## Admissions and Applications

- [Applying](https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/applying.html): Complete admissions hub for domestic & international student applications
- [How to apply](https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/applying/how-to-apply.html): Step-by-step application guide for undergraduate & postgraduate programs
- [Educational Access Scheme](https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/applying/admission-pathways/educational-access-scheme.html): EAS adjustment factors for educationally disadvantaged domestic students
- [Transferring students](https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/applying/admission-pathways/transferring.html): Course transfers, university transfers & credit for previous study
- [Tertiary Preparation Certificate Entry Scheme](https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/applying/admission-pathways/tpc-scheme.html): TPC pathway for non-traditional domestic students via TAFE to Sydney

## International Students

- [Chinese International Students](https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/international-students/chinese-international-students.html): 2026 applications for Chinese students to study at top-ranked Sydney
- [Chinese International Students (中文)](https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/international-students/chinese-international-students-cn.html): Chinese language recruitment page for 2026 international applications
- [Study abroad at Sydney](https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/study-options/study-abroad-at-sydney.html): Exchange & study abroad programs for international partner universities

## Financial Support and Costs

- [Scholarships](https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/fees-and-loans/scholarships.html): Hundreds of scholarships for domestic & international students at Sydney
- [Living costs](https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/fees-and-loans/other-costs/living-costs.html): Budget planner & living cost guide for students in Sydney, Australia

## Student Life and Support

- [Student support](https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/student-life/student-support.html): Counselling, disability, Indigenous & international student support services
- [Student news](https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/student-life/latest-news.html): Latest news & updates for current and prospective Sydney students

## Study Programs

- [Honours](https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/study-options/honours.html): Fourth-year research degree following undergraduate studies at Sydney

## Urban Research and Innovation

- [Henry Halloran Urban and Regional Research Initiative](https://www.sydney.edu.au/halloran-urban-initiative/home.html): Urban planning & development research initiative with grants & programs
- [Henry Halloran Urban and Regional Research Initiative](https://www.sydney.edu.au/halloran-urban-initiative.html): Town planning & urban development research with Festival of Urbanism
- [Climate Change, Place and Mental Health Incubator](https://www.sydney.edu.au/halloran-urban-initiative/research-grants-and-programs/climate-change-place-and-mental-health-incubator.html): Cross-disciplinary research on climate change & mental health impacts
- [Research outputs - Infrastructure Governance Incubator](https://www.sydney.edu.au/halloran-urban-initiative/research-grants-and-programs/infrastructure-governance-incubator/research-outputs.html): Infrastructure Governance Incubator research outputs on Western Sydney
- [Media mentions](https://www.sydney.edu.au/halloran-urban-initiative/news-and-media/members-in-the-media.html): Halloran Initiative media coverage on housing policy & urban research

- [Sydney Innovative Challenge Registration](https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/international-students/sydney-innovation-challenge/sydney-innovative-challenge-registration.html): Registration for Sydney Innovation Challenge events (applications closed)
